```{r setup, include = FALSE}
# The PDF the frame writes beside every published analysis.
#
# Knitted to markdown and handed to pandoc, never rendered by rmarkdown::pdf_document, which is
# bound to LaTeX and ignores --pdf-engine.
#
# The spec is written by analysis/lib/nf/report.nf: what produced the folder, the warnings its
# design carries, the module's own report if it declares one, and every file the module declared
# with the summary it declared. The folder itself is POOLSEQFLOW_REPORT_FOLDER.
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, error = FALSE)

# Characters are read and written as UTF-8 whatever locale the task inherited. Outside one, R
# writes the report's own pi and its breaks as <U+03C0> and <U+200B>, and a name with an accent in
# it as bytes.
if (!isTRUE(l10n_info()[["UTF-8"]])) {
    for (locale in c("C.UTF-8", "C.utf8", "en_US.UTF-8", "en_US.utf8")) {
        if (nzchar(suppressWarnings(Sys.setlocale("LC_CTYPE", locale)))) break
    }
    if (!isTRUE(l10n_info()[["UTF-8"]])) {
        stop("report: this machine has no UTF-8 locale (tried C.UTF-8, C.utf8, en_US.UTF-8 ",
             "and en_US.utf8), and the report cannot print its own symbols or a pool name ",
             "with an accent without one")
    }
}

spec <- jsonlite::fromJSON(Sys.getenv("POOLSEQFLOW_REPORT_SPEC"), simplifyVector = FALSE)
source(spec$library)
```

# `r spec$module`: `r spec$label`

Produced by PoolSeqFlow `r spec$release`, module `r spec$module` v`r spec$version` and analysis frame `r spec$frame`, on `r format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")`.

Read from `r paste0("\x60", spec$source, "\x60")`.

```{r warnings, results = "asis"}
if (length(spec$warnings) > 0) {
    cat("\n## Read these before the numbers\n\n")
    for (note in spec$warnings) cat("- ", note, "\n", sep = "")
    cat("\n")
}
```

```{r body, results = "asis"}
if (nzchar(spec$child)) {
    cat(knitr::knit_child(spec$child, quiet = TRUE), sep = "\n")
} else {
    report_declared(spec$outputs)
}
```

Every number here is in a file in this folder, and `README.md` says which file holds what.
